title: Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that…
description: Cloud Commander versions before 19.21.4 have an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending specially crafted PUT /rename requests that are processed before authentication checks. Attackers can use absolute or relative paths to move files outside the intended root directory, potentially causing data loss or denial of service.
